
        <h2>
            <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/witz/p/19098038" title="发布于 2025-09-18 09:01">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Centos7非LVM根分区容量不足后扩容，对调硬盘挂载/</span>
    

</a>

        </h2>
        <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span><span>背景：用户物理机，物理硬盘对应的根分区容量不足，且非LVM无法热扩容。</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>思路：加一块或者多块硬盘做lvm，暂时挂载到新路径/newroot；拷贝根分区全部内容到<span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>/newroot,更改引导，从新分区启动，重启后容量大的硬盘挂载到/，小硬盘暂时不挂载，后续可以改LVM扩容进来。</span></span></span></span></p>
<p><img alt="442eba37aa5d98720ccd75e6af401fbf" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1573482/202509/1573482-20250918085757426-477875644.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="background-color: rgba(0, 255, 0, 1)">实操步骤</span></p>
<p><span><span>建议先用虚机测试后再实操，下面是<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">虚机测试过程</span>。操作前，vda对应根分区，操作后，vdb对应根分区</span></span></p>
<p><span><span><span style="background-color: rgba(0, 255, 0, 1)">第一步，</span>分区 &nbsp;8e</span></span></p>
<p><span>fdisk /dev/vdb</span></p>
<p><img alt="21B(8{0`EVGY1K(MH{8H53G" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1573482/202509/1573482-20250918085931761-66382142.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><span><span style="background-color: rgba(0, 255, 0, 1)">第二步，</span>&nbsp;迁移复制 &nbsp;对比大小</span></span></p>
<p><span>rsync -avxHAX / /newroot &nbsp;--info=progress2</span></p>
<p><img alt="CE)5{0XWN@%U6F6C(0]$PO8" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1573482/202509/1573482-20250918085947882-1912610849.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><span><span style="background-color: rgba(0, 255, 0, 1)">第三步，</span>&nbsp;更新/boot下的引导新型</span></span></p>
<p><span>&nbsp;grub2-mkconfig -o /boot/grub2/grub.cfg</span></p>
<p><img alt="QSI8DXZIF)U[NDFR)($TGM7" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1573482/202509/1573482-20250918085955037-1749913149.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><span><span style="background-color: rgba(0, 255, 0, 1)">第四步，</span>更改新root目录下 fstab的 uuid</span></span></p>
<p><span>blkid 查询uuid</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><span><span style="background-color: rgba(0, 255, 0, 1)">第五步，</span>更新启动加载项</span></span></p>
<p><span>&nbsp;grub2-install /dev/vdb</span></p>
<p><span>如果有报错，实际可能是裸盘使用没有进一步分区，可以调整后再操作</span></p>
<p><img alt="RT6X$908{I]~{B9(M@T79$W" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1573482/202509/1573482-20250918090014384-2099601846.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><span><span style="background-color: rgba(0, 255, 0, 1)">更六步，</span>更新initramfs</span></span></p>
<p><span>dracut -f /boot/initramfs-$(uname -r).img $(uname -r)</span></p>
<p><img alt="2Q`A9GM~V(0X}ALVS_]9{RI" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1573482/202509/1573482-20250918090021141-1736788832.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><span><span style="background-color: rgba(0, 255, 0, 1)">第七步，</span>&nbsp;注释掉/boot配置文件中旧的启动项,大概是在87~118行:</span></span></p>
<p><span>vim /boot/grub2/grub.cfg</span></p>
<p><img alt="PN[]CBOAF%_48R8I7TJ$L%4" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1573482/202509/1573482-20250918090038503-1760295708.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span>&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span><span><span style="background-color: rgba(0, 255, 0, 1)">第八步，</span>重启验证 （从vda对应/，变为vdb对应/）</span></span></p>
<p><img alt="DL0B@_AGWH(2R]KSGL}6OG9" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1573482/202509/1573482-20250918090047338-1738276557.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
